breakdown.description: The specified outer-boundary point load is replaced by a distributed end traction
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to replace the point load with a uniform traction. The ground truth corrects this, specifying the use of a `PointSource` for the concentrated load. The generated specification repeated the error, stating: 'A total downward load of 5 kN will be applied as a uniform traction distribution on the entire right edge (x=1)'.
